description: ToolHive runs Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers in isolated containers with fine-grained permissions and network controls. Includes the thv CLI, a Kubernetes operator, the Virtual MCP (vMCP) gateway, and registry, skills, and plugin management.
rules: The ToolHive CLI binary is `thv`. Install it with `brew install stacklok/tap/thv` or `winget install stacklok.thv`.
`thv skill` and `thv ai-plugin` commands go through the ToolHive API, so start `thv serve` first.

ToolHive custom resources use apiVersion `toolhive.stacklok.dev/v1beta1`, except `MCPWebhookConfig`, which uses `toolhive.stacklok.dev/v1alpha1`. Install the `toolhive-operator-crds` Helm chart before the `toolhive-operator` chart.
Store credentials with `thv secret set` and reference them by name rather than passing tokens inline with `-e`.
End-user guides and reference live at docs.stacklok.com/toolhive.
